theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.heckeH_pos {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) :
0 < heckeH q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.L_strict_mono {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < heckeH q) (hd0 : 0 < deltaPN q) (hd2 : deltaPN q < 2) :
L_pp q < L_pn q ∧ L_pn q < L_nn q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.factors_strict_mono {q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < heckeH q) (hd0 : 0 < deltaPN q) (hd2 : deltaPN q < 2) :
markovZ q - heckeH q < markovZ q + dPN q ∧ markovZ q + dPN q < markovZ q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.dPN_strict_between {q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < heckeH q) (hd0 : 0 < deltaPN q) (hd2 : deltaPN q < 2) :
-heckeH q < dPN q ∧ dPN q < 0

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.convex_weights_sum (q : ℝ) :
1 / 2 + deltaPN q / 4 + (1 / 2 - deltaPN q / 4) = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.dPN_eq_convex (q : ℝ) :
dPN q = (1 / 2 + deltaPN q / 4) * 0 + (1 / 2 - deltaPN q / 4) * -heckeH q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.L_nn_eq {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
L_nn q = Real.log q + Real.log (q ^ 2 + 1)

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.L_pp_add_L_nn {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
L_pp q + L_nn q = 2 * Real.log (q + q⁻¹)

-Real.log (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, -Real.log (f i)

0 < markovZ q + dPN q

0 ≤ deltaPN q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.heckeH_nonneg {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
0 ≤ heckeH q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.mirror_pos {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
0 < markovZ q - heckeH q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.markovZ_pos {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
0 < markovZ q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.markovZ_mul_mirror (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
markovZ q * (markovZ q - heckeH q) = 1 / (q + q⁻¹) ^ 2

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.markovZ_sub_heckeH (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
markovZ q - heckeH q = 1 / (q * (q ^ 2 + 1))

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.twoStrandTrace_zero (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
twoStrandTrace q 0 = markovZ q

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.twoStrandTrace_eq (q d : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
twoStrandTrace q d = markovZ q + d

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.wPlus_add_wMinus (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
wPlus q + wMinus q = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.wMinus_eq (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
wMinus q = q ^ 2 / (q ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.wPlus_eq (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
wPlus q = (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1) / (q ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.qint3_add_one (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
qint3 q + 1 = (q ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 / q ^ 2

theorem QOU.Mass.ChainTraceFactor.qint3_eq (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
qint3 q = (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 2
